about: The default keyboard shortcuts of Archie DAW (desktop), as DATA. Each entry binds a key combination to a COMMAND: either a tool from studio-tools.json (so keyboard, buttons, web pages and Archie share one path and one undo) or a console action named ui.* (listed in uiCommands). The person's own changes are saved beside the skin. Source of the Reason entries: a list of what Reason provides, collected on 2026-11-20, kept so we can use what we need and invent the rest. Every entry says how real it is: ready (works now), progress (being built), pending (the feature it needs does not exist yet).
keys: Ctrl means Ctrl on Windows and Command on a Mac. A key list is alternatives.

contexts.global: anywhere in the program except a text box and a plug-in's own window
contexts.mixer: when the Mixer view is showing
contexts.rack: when the Rack view is showing
contexts.sequencer: when the sequencer is showing (not built yet)

uiCommands.ui.toggleEditArea: show or hide the edit area
uiCommands.ui.returnToStart: move the playhead to the start
uiCommands.ui.toggleKeyboardPiano: the computer keyboard plays notes (A S D F ...) on or off
uiCommands.ui.showOnScreenPiano: show or hide the on-screen piano keys
uiCommands.ui.showSpectrum: show or hide the spectrum EQ / analyser window
uiCommands.ui.showDevicePalette: show or hide the device palette (the plug-in browser)
uiCommands.ui.searchDevices: show the device palette with the search box ready
uiCommands.ui.browseForSelected: open the browser focused on the selected device
uiCommands.ui.showRecordingMeter: show or hide the recording meter
uiCommands.ui.flipRack: turn the rack to its back panel and front again
uiCommands.ui.saveProjectAs: save the project under a new name
uiCommands.ui.closeWindow: close the active detached window or the project
uiCommands.ui.delete: delete the selected devices, tracks, clips or notes
uiCommands.ui.selectAll: select everything in the active area
uiCommands.ui.routeToNewBus: route the selected tracks to a new output bus
uiCommands.ui.createInstrumentTrack: create an instrument track and open the device palette
uiCommands.ui.copy: copy the chosen notes (pointer over the piano roll) or the selected clip
uiCommands.ui.cut: cut the chosen notes (pointer over the piano roll)
uiCommands.ui.paste: paste: the copied notes into the piano roll at the playhead, or a copy of the copied clip at the playhead on the selected track
uiCommands.ui.splitAtPlayhead: cut the selected clip in two at the playhead
uiCommands.ui.addInstrument: open the device browser on the instruments, to add one to the selected channel
uiCommands.ui.addEffect: open the device browser on the effects, to add one to the selected channel
uiCommands.ui.addClip: add an empty note clip at the playhead on the selected track

bindings.note: stop; a second tap returns to the start, which is how Stop already works
arm / start recording; a 'start button arm record' key was asked for: still to be confirmed
Reason: Save Song As (the save dialog always lets the person choose a name)
Reason: close the active detached Rack or Mixer window / close the Song
Reason: Exit (Windows); the operating system provides this
Reason: Import Audio File (opens the file chooser and puts the sound on the selected track at the playhead)
Reason: Create Audio Track (our tracks are one kind: this adds a track)
Reason: Add Instrument. Here: opens the device browser on the instruments
Reason: Spectrum EQ window (ours: the Analyser)
Reason: Device Palette with the search field focused
Reason: Open Browser without Browse Focus
Reason: Open Browser with Browse Focus for the selected device
Reason: Delete. Here: the chosen notes while the pointer is over the piano roll, otherwise the selected clip
Reason: Duplicate. Here: copy the chosen notes after themselves while the pointer is over the piano roll, otherwise copy the selected clip (shared)
Reason: Select All. Here: every note in the piano roll while the pointer is over it
Reason: Route to New Output Bus
Copy (notes in the piano roll, or the selected clip)
Paste (notes into the piano roll, or a copy of the clip at the playhead)
Reason: Split Clips at Song Position
Reason: Add Effect. Here: opens the device browser on the effects
Hot cue 1: jump to that loop (makes it at the playhead when empty). The plain number keys stay the tools
Hot cue 2: jump to that loop (makes it at the playhead when empty). The plain number keys stay the tools
Hot cue 3: jump to that loop (makes it at the playhead when empty). The plain number keys stay the tools
Panic: silence everything, even a hung note (2026-11-21: a note hung and could not be shut down)
Tap tempo (a letter on its own is a piano key, so it has Shift)
